This [[uniform polyhedron compound]] is a [[Chirality (mathematics)|chiral]] symmetric arrangement of 10 [[triangular prism]]s, aligned with the axes of three-fold rotational symmetry of an [[icosahedron]].

== Related polyhedra ==

This compound shares its [[vertex arrangement]] with three [[uniform polyhedron|uniform polyhedra]] as follows:
